paite: Paul, Silvanas leh Timothi in, Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist saptuam Thessalonika a omte kiang ah, Pathian i paleh Toupa Jesu Khrist a pan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Ka thumna uah na min uh lou in, nou tengteng ziak in Pathian kiang ah kipahthu ka gen gige uhi.
heading: Thessalonikate Phathuaina
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

paite: I Pathian leh Pa ma ah ginna ziak a na thilhihdan uh leh itna ziak a na sepgimdante uh, Toupa Jesu Khrist lametna ziak a na kuhkalna uh mangngilh lou a, theigige in.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

paite: Unau Pathian ngaihtakte aw, nou ahon teldan ka thei uhi.
english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

paite: Ka tanchinhoih uh thu kia a na kiang uh hong tung lou in thilhihtheihna leh Kha Siangthou leh nakpi a theihchetna toh ahong tung zaw hi. Noumau makhua ngaihtuah in na tung uah bangchibang mi ka hita ua chih na thei uhi.
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

paite: Huan thuhaksa thuak kawm in, Kha Siangthou a kipak in na pom ua, koumau leh Toupa zuite na hita uhi.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

paite: Huchi in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a gingtu mi tengteng a ding in etton ding na hi uhi.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

paite: Toupa thu noumau a kipan in Masidonia leh Akhaia gam kia hilou, mun chih ah Pathian lam a na ginna uh athangkheta hi, kou bangmah ka gen uh akiphamoh nawn kei hi.
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

paite: Amau mahmah in bangchibang vualzawlna toh na kiang ua ka hong lutdan uh ahon theisak uhi. Nou milimte a kipan a Pathian lam na hong ngat takdan uleh Pathian hing leh dik nasem ding leh,
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

paite: van a kipan a Tapa, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, thangpaihna hong tung ding lak a kipan hon suaktasakpa, huai Jesu ngei na ngak ding in.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
